title.narrative: MultiDonor Trust Fund for Cofinancing of the Public Expenditures for Administrative Capacity Endurance in Ukraine Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Trust Fund is to co-finance Bank supported Expenditures for Administrative Capacity Endurance in Ukraine Project (PEACE) (P178946) (the Project)comma which aims to contribute to sustaining Ukraine’s administrative and service delivery capacity to exercise core government functions at the national and regional levels.
